title: Darkroom Adds Haré+Guu Deluxe Anime
content: Streaming service Darkroom has added the Haré+Guu Deluxe anime with the English dub for streaming with a premium membership. The series is an adaptation of Renjuro Kindaichi 's Jungle wa Itsumo Hare Nochi Guu manga.
author: ANN

title: Absolute Batman’s Creator Made an Attack on Titan Sequel (And You Probably Haven’t Read It)
content: One of the biggest comic books on the market nowadays is Absolute Batman , the DC Comic that re-imagines the story of Bruce Wayne and Gotham City in some wild ways. Helping push this new line of comics to the forefront, the series has been brought to life by writer Scott Snyder and artist Nick Dragotta.
author: ComicBook

title: Kindergarten for Divine Beasts Webtoon Gets AI-Based Animated TV Series
content: The web novel and webtoon Kindergarten for Divine Beasts is being adapted into a broadcast animation using artificial intelligence (AI), marking another step in the expansion of webtoon-based IP into new formats.
author: ANN

title: The Amazing Digital Circus Steps Into The Manga World With This Big Reveal
content: We are weeks away from saying a final goodbye to The Amazing Digital Circus , as the beloved web series is taking a major jump from being an online exclusive to a theatrical outing.

title: Bite Maker AK Manga Ends
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Miwako Sugiyama 's Bite Maker: AK (Area Kanazawa) manga announced on Saturday that the manga will end on Shogakukan 's Biccomi platform on May 30. The series launched on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in May 2023.

title: Kakao Ent. Opens Submissions for New Drama Webtoon Series
content: Kakao Entertainment announced on May 13 that it will accept submissions for new drama-genre webtoons from May 27 through June 10, as part of its ongoing effort to expand its content pipeline.
